recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes to gender identity, pronouns, RSG, or SPCU extension definitions should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack; core should only be changed if the Patient narrative diverges from current Gender Harmony guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-29673 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration issue for R5 requesting updates to the Patient Gender and Sex section for Gender Harmony, including Sex for Clinical Use, Recorded Sex or Gender, updated sex assigned at birth language, gender identity/pronouns handling, and related standard extensions.
initial_application: The issue was applied historically through the FHIR-29673 gender-harmony branch merged as 59f7e56b6c3ddae75195e82628fabe15328556b1, with branch commits such as 76b1f6db879c785cf4ee1a3b98897ebc0576cefb and 5fa4ec6a53c15a2a9b401ad4cb2867b2b458a7f1 updating Patient narrative and extension definitions. PA minutes record the 2021-12-22 3-0-0 disposition, and Gender Harmony minutes later approved the branch content for merge into FHIR CI.
additional_context: Later applied/published follow-ups refined the same content: FHIR-38861 added use-case guidance, FHIR-39202 removed openly-known gender identity language, FHIR-39201 made clinical observations a sibling bullet, FHIR-39219 renamed SFCU to SPCU, and FHIR-44895 moved the Patient Gender and Sex link into the Patient.gender definition for visibility. The extension definitions were later removed from core source and are present in the FHIR Extension Pack, where subsequent FHIR-extensions issues such as FHIR-48938 and FHIR-51448 continue to maintain SPCU.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Patient source contains the Patient Gender and Sex section with Administrative Gender, Gender Identity/pronouns, Sex Parameter for Clinical Use, clinical observations, Recorded Sex or Gender, Legal Sex, and Sex assigned at Birth guidance, and Patient.gender links to that section. The requested extension artifacts are available in the Extension Pack rather than as current editable core source.

related_jiras.note: Requested expanding genderIdentity context to Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and Person; closed as duplicate of FHIR-29673, and current extension-pack context includes those resources.
Refined Patient.gender versus RSG guidance in the same Patient section.
Made clinical observations about sex characteristics a sibling bullet in the same Patient section.
Removed problematic openly-known language from Gender Identity guidance.
Renamed Sex for Clinical Use to Sex Parameter for Clinical Use and supplied the current description.
Improved visibility of the Patient Gender and Sex section from Patient.gender.
Later Extension Pack change adding intendedClinicalUse to SPCU; confirms ongoing extension maintenance outside core.
